title: Water/Pasta - 7 minutes. Fried or Scrambles -- about an hour.
text: Water/Pasta - 7 minutes. Fried or Scrambles -- about an hour.. I spent way to much time comparing single burners -- this one works just fine for the price. It boils my water for pasta or vegetables in about 7 minutes. The only problem I have is when I am making a scramble in the morning -- it turns off and on and it takes about 40 minutes to fry thinly shredded potatoes and another 15 after scrambling in the eggs. Almost an hour to make breakfast is a bit nuts. I'll be purchasing a different kind soon -- however, if you're not a breakfast person, it works well.

The 1,000 Watt Self-Cleaning Element and the Stainless Steel Drip Tray allow you to concentrate on your delicious concoction and forget about any messy cleanup. Featuring an easy to use thermostatic control and simple to read power indicator light, the IMUSA Stainless Steel Electric Single Burner is like a compact, convenient, and portable kitchen.
